name: application-cookie-consent
title: Cookie Consent Banner
description: Bottom-anchored cookie consent banner with accept-all, reject-non-essential, and customize actions, plus an expanded per-category preferences panel.
useWhen: The site sets non-essential cookies (analytics, personalization) and needs explicit user consent before running them.
Compliance requires offering granular accept/reject/customize choices, not just a single dismiss button.
You need a persistent bottom banner that doesn't block the rest of the page like a modal would.
avoidWhen: Only strictly necessary cookies are used — no consent banner is legally required in that case.
The message is unrelated to cookies/privacy — use announcement-banner for general product or maintenance notices instead.
You need a blocking, must-choose gate before any content loads — this banner is non-blocking by design; wrap it in your own gating logic if required.
responsiveBehavior: The banner spans the full viewport width and stacks the description above the action buttons on narrow screens, placing them side by side from the sm breakpoint up.
accessibility: The banner uses role="dialog" with an aria-label and aria-describedby linking to the consent copy.
The essential-cookies toggle is rendered checked and disabled, with reduced opacity, to visually and programmatically convey it cannot be turned off.
Category toggles are real checkboxes with an associated label, so they're operable by keyboard and screen readers without extra ARIA.

variants.title: Consent banner
variants.description: Initial bottom banner with a consent summary and accept-all, reject-non-essential, and customize actions.
accessibility: All three actions are real buttons reachable by keyboard in a logical tab order.

variants.title: Consent banner (Dark)
variants.description: Bottom consent banner adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Button and text colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.

variants.title: Preferences panel
variants.description: Expanded customize panel with a toggle per cookie category (essential locked on) and a save action.
accessibility: The disabled essential toggle still exposes its checked state to assistive tech via the native disabled checkbox.

variants.title: Preferences panel (Dark)
variants.description: Expanded cookie preferences panel adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Toggle track and thumb colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
